title: Generative AI in Software Testing: Practitioners' Perspectives on the Benefits, Challenges, Opportunities, and Risks
abstract: arXiv:2611.23256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) increasingly supports software testing, yet empirical evidence on practitioners' perceptions remains limited. This study investigates perceived benefits, challenges, opportunities, and risks of GenAI in software testing through a questionnaire survey of 64 practitioners. Closed-ended responses were analyzed descriptively, while open-ended responses were qualitatively coded to contextualize the findings. Among the respondents, 34 were users (those with regular or experimental use of GenAI in testing) and 30 were non-users (those without prior use of GenAI in testing). Results show generally positive perceptions of GenAI for reducing effort, test generation, and debugging, alongside concerns about prompt dependence, trust, and incorrect outputs. translated_title: 生成式人工智能在软件测试中的应用：从业者对益处、挑战、机遇与风险的看法
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能日益支持软件测试工作，但关于从业者感知的实证证据仍然有限。本研究通过对64名从业者进行问卷调查，探讨了GenAI在软件测试中被感知到的益处、挑战、机遇与风险。封闭式问题的回答采用描述性方法分析，开放式问题的回答则通过定性编码进行情境化解读。在受访者中，34人为使用者（经常或在试验中使用GenAI进行测试的人员），30人为非使用者（此前未在测试中使用过GenAI的人员）。结果表明，从业者普遍对GenAI在减少工作量、测试生成和调试方面的作用持积极态度，但同时也对提示词依赖、信任问题和错误输出表示担忧。使用者对若干具体益处的评价更为积极，同时也更频繁地将可靠性相关风险列为优先关注事项，而非使用者则表现出更加……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 一项针对64名软件测试从业者的问卷调查显示，从业者普遍认可生成式AI在减少工作量、测试生成和调试方面的益处，但也担心提示词依赖、信任问题和错误输出，且使用者比非使用者更关注具体收益与可靠性风险。
en_tdlr: A survey of 64 software testing practitioners reveals generally positive perceptions of generative AI for reducing effort, test generation, and debugging, alongside concerns about prompt dependence, trust, and incorrect outputs, with users being more positive about concrete benefits yet more focused on reliability-related risks.
